entries.dialogueText: “I will do whatever it takes to eliminate this threat.”
entries.menuText: “I will do whatever it takes to eliminate this threat.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Mr. President. I beg you to see re..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. I beg you to see reason.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“We have done our research.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We have done our research.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“With that attitude, I have no doub..."
entries.dialogueText: “With that attitude, I have no doubt that we will succeed.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“But I'm afraid simply having the v..."
entries.dialogueText: “But I'm afraid simply having the vaccines won't help. We need to make sure they are administered.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“There is a cure. A vaccine was rec..."
entries.dialogueText: “There is a cure. A vaccine was recently invented in United Contana, and the formula has been made available for free across the entire world.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“No matter what people think about..."
entries.dialogueText: “No matter what people think about United Contana, if the same thing had happened in Arcasia, we would be paying a steep price for it.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Thanks to the very good decision m..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thanks to the very good decision made by you to increase funding for our healthcare, we have the capability to produce this vaccine locally.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Unfortunately, because of the stat..."
entries.dialogueText: “Unfortunately, because of the state of our current funding, we have neither the required materials nor the capability to produce this vaccine locally.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Which means we have to buy it. It..."
entries.dialogueText: “Which means we have to buy it. It will be costly but nothing comes before health.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You are exaggerating. There have b..."
entries.dialogueText: “You are exaggerating. There have been fewer than 30 deaths and you said the infected were under quarantine. I'm not going to approve this procurement.”
entries.menuText: “You are exaggerating. There have been fewer than 30 deaths and you said the infected were under quarantine. I'm not going to approve this procurement.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Procure whatever you need. Immedia..."
entries.dialogueText: “Procure whatever you need. Immediately.”
entries.menuText: “Procure whatever you need. Immediately. [-1 Government Budget]”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Mr. President. You are knowingly e..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. You are knowingly exposing Sordland to the dangers of this virus.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Polio doesn't distinguish. It can..."
entries.dialogueText: “Polio doesn't distinguish. It can infect you, your daughter, your son, your wife. Think about them.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“I beg you to reconsider.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I beg you to reconsider.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We don't have enough funds. I alre..."
entries.dialogueText: “We don't have enough funds. I already told you my decision.”
entries.menuText: “We don't have enough funds. I already told you my decision.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“When you put it that way...Very we..."
entries.dialogueText: “When you put it that way...Very well. Procure whatever you need.”
entries.menuText: “When you put it that way...Very well. Procure whatever you need. [-1 Government Budget]”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Then may God save us all.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Then may God save us all.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“You will not regret this, Mr. Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: “You will not regret this, Mr. President. I assure you.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“You have once again proven that yo..."
entries.dialogueText: “You have once again proven that you are the right leader for Sordland in my eyes.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Right away, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Right away, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“This is a great first step.”"
entries.dialogueText: “This is a great first step.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“We need to implement a nationwide..."
entries.dialogueText: “We need to implement a nationwide mandatory Polio vaccination policy.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“With your order, I can immediately..."
entries.dialogueText: “With your order, I can immediately get to work to ensure we are doing whatever it takes.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“This might seem excessive however,..."
entries.dialogueText: “This might seem excessive however, it is absolutely necessary.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Whatever it takes to protect Sordl..."
entries.dialogueText: “Whatever it takes to protect Sordland. Do it.”
entries.menuText: “Whatever it takes to protect Sordland. Do it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's observe the situation first...."
entries.dialogueText: “Let's observe the situation first. We will be fine without it for now.”
entries.menuText: “Let's observe the situation first. We will be fine without it for now.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Very well. I will keep you up to d..."
entries.dialogueText: “Very well. I will keep you up to date.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Excellent.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Excellent.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Now, if you will excuse me, I must..."
entries.dialogueText: “Now, if you will excuse me, I must get to work immediately.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Paskal's shoulders dropped in defea..."
entries.dialogueText: Paskal's shoulders dropped in defeat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He got up from his seat."
entries.dialogueText: He got up from his seat.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“That was it for today, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: “That was it for today, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“I have done all I could.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I have done all I could.”

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: "“Thank you for your time, Mr. Presi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for your time, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He left my office, leaving me alone..."
entries.dialogueText: He left my office, leaving me alone with a lot of paperwork to go through.
